description: Put study blocks (from study_plan) on your personal Canvas calendar, or add them as planner notes. Only you see them. At most 60 blocks per call. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

add_to.description: "calendar" (default) for timed calendar events, or "planner" for to-do notes.

blocks.description: The blocks to add, usually copied from study_plan.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

name: schedule_study_plan
title: Schedule Study Plan
